verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בִשְׁמוֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֣ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת שָׁנָ֡ה לְצֵ֣את בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַיִם֩ בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הָרְבִיעִ֜ית בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ זִ֗ו ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לִמְלֹ֥ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּ֥בֶן הַבַּ֖יִת לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇiš·mō·w·nîm šā·nāh wə·’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh lə·ṣêṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim baš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇî·‘îṯ bə·ḥō·ḏeš ziw hū ha·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî lim·lōḵ šə·lō·mōh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·yi·ḇen hab·ba·yiṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites . . . had come out of the land of Egypt in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel in the month of Ziv the second month he began to build the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: No ano quatrocentos e oitenta, depois que saíram da terra do Egito os filhos de Israel, no quarto ano do reinado de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de zive, que é o segundo mês, começou-se a edificar a Casa de Jeová.

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשִּֽׁים־ אַמָּ֥ה אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים רָחְבּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh Yah·weh šiš·šîm- ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw wə·‘eś·rîm rā·ḥə·bōw ū·šə·lō·šîm ’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long twenty cubits wide and thirty cubits high
verses.literalPt: A casa que Salomão edificou para Jeová tinha sessenta cúbitos de comprido, vinte de largo e trinta de alto.

verses.original: וְהָאוּלָ֗ם עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַבַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַבָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ū·lām ‘al- pə·nê hê·ḵal hab·ba·yiṯ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh ’ā·rə·kōw ‘al- pə·nê rō·ḥaḇ hab·bā·yiṯ ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw ‘al- pə·nê hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple was twenty cubits long extending across . . . the width of the temple and projecting out ten cubits in front of the temple
verses.literalPt: O pórtico diante do templo da casa estendia-se por vinte cúbitos no sentido da largura da casa e projetava-se por dez cúbitos à frente da mesma.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לַבָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lab·bā·yiṯ ḥal·lō·w·nê šə·qu·p̄îm ’ă·ṭu·mîm
verses.literal: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple
verses.literalPt: Para a casa fez janelas de gelosias fixas.

verses.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ עַל־ קִ֨יר הַבַּ֤יִת יָצוֹעַ סָבִ֔יב אֶת־ קִיר֤וֹת הַבַּ֙יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַדְּבִ֑יר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ‘al- qîr hab·ba·yiṯ yå̄·ṣō·aʿ sā·ḇîḇ ’eṯ- qî·rō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ la·hê·ḵāl wə·lad·də·ḇîr way·ya·‘aś ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Against the walls of the temple and the inner sanctuary Solomon built a chambered structure around - the temple in which he constructed the side rooms
verses.literalPt: Contra a parede da casa, tanto do templo como do oráculo, edificou andares ao redor e fez câmaras laterais ao redor;

verses.original: הַיָּצוֹעַ הַתַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗הּ וְהַתִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּאַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַבַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּקִֽירוֹת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yå̄·ṣō·aʿ hat·taḥ·tō·nāh ḥā·mêš bā·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh wə·hat·tî·ḵō·nāh šêš bā·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh wə·haš·šə·lî·šîṯ še·ḇa‘ bā·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh kî miḡ·rā·‘ō·wṯ nā·ṯan lab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ ḥū·ṣāh lə·ḇil·tî ’ă·ḥōz bə·qî·rō·wṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The bottom floor was five cubits wide the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven cubits - He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into its walls
verses.literalPt: o andar de baixo tinha cinco cúbitos de largo; o do meio, seis; e o terceiro, sete, porque, pelo lado de fora, na parede da casa fez encostas, para que as vigas não estribassem nas paredes da casa.

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּהִבָּ֣נֹת֔וֹ אֶֽבֶן־ שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּמַקָּב֤וֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל־ כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא־ נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּבַּ֖יִת בְּהִבָּנֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ bə·hib·bā·nō·ṯōw ’e·ḇen- šə·lê·māh mas·sā‘ niḇ·nāh ū·maq·qā·ḇō·wṯ wə·hag·gar·zen kāl- kə·lî ḇar·zel lō- niš·ma‘ bab·ba·yiṯ bə·hib·bā·nō·ṯōw
verses.literal: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built
verses.literalPt: Ao edificar-se a casa, empregavam-se pedras preparadas na pedreira; não se ouviu na casa martelo, nem machado, nem instrumento algum de ferro, enquanto ela se edificava.

verses.original: פֶּ֗תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל־ כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת הַיְמָנִ֑ית וּבְלוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל־ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּמִן־ הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: pe·ṯaḥ haṣ·ṣê·lā‘ hat·tî·ḵō·nāh ’el- ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ hay·mā·nîṯ ū·ḇə·lūl·lîm ya·‘ă·lū ‘al- hat·tî·ḵō·nāh ū·min- hat·tî·ḵō·nāh ’el- haš·šə·li·šîm
verses.literal: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple A stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third floor
verses.literalPt: A porta para as câmaras laterais do meio estava à banda direita da casa; subiam por uma escada para o andar do meio e do andar do meio, para o terceiro.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּ֑הוּ וַיִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּשְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּאֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ way·ḵal·lê·hū way·yis·pōn ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ gê·ḇîm ū·śə·ḏê·rōṯ bā·’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: So Solomon built the temple and finished it roofing it with beams and planks of cedar
verses.literalPt: Assim, edificou a casa e a acabou, cobrindo-a com traves e pranchas de cedro.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן אֶת־ הַיָּצוֹעַ עַל־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- hay·yå̄·ṣō·aʿ ‘al- kāl- hab·ba·yiṯ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ qō·w·mā·ṯōw way·ye·’ĕ·ḥōz ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ba·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: He built chambers all along . . . the temple each five cubits high and attached to the temple with beams of cedar
verses.literalPt: Os andares que edificou contra a casa toda eram de cinco cúbitos de altura, e os ligou à casa com madeira de cedro.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- šə·lō·mōh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon saying
verses.literalPt: Então, veio a palavra de Jeová a Salomão, dizendo:

verses.original: הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה בֹנֶ֗ה אִם־ תֵּלֵ֤ךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֥ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֖י לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־ דְּבָרִי֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh ḇō·neh ’im- tê·lêḵ bə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay ta·‘ă·śeh wə·šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯay lā·le·ḵeṯ bā·hem wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rî ’it·tāḵ ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: As for this temple you are building if you walk in My statutes carry out My ordinances and keep all My commandments by walking in them I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David
verses.literalPt: Quanto a esta casa que tu estás edificando, se andares nos meus estatutos, e executares os meus juízos, e guardares todos os meus mandamentos, andando neles, estabelecerei contigo a minha palavra que falei a Davi, teu pai.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א אֶעֱזֹ֖ב אֶת־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḵan·tî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·zōḇ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And I will dwell among the Israelites . . . and will not abandon My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Habitarei no meio dos filhos de Israel e não abandonarei o meu povo de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ way·ḵal·lê·hū
verses.literal: So Solomon built the temple and finished it
verses.literalPt: Salomão edificou a casa e acabou-a.

verses.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־ קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֤יִת מִבַּ֙יְתָה֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִקַּרְקַ֤ע הַבַּ֙יִת֙ עַד־ קִיר֣וֹת הַסִּפֻּ֔ן צִפָּ֥ה עֵ֖ץ מִבָּ֑יִת וַיְצַ֛ף אֶת־ קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת בְּצַלְע֥וֹת בְּרוֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- qî·rō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ mib·bay·ṯāh bə·ṣal·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·rā·zîm miq·qar·qa‘ hab·ba·yiṯ ‘aḏ- qî·rō·wṯ has·sip·pun ṣip·pāh ‘êṣ mib·bā·yiṯ way·ṣap̄ ’eṯ- qar·qa‘ hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ṣal·‘ō·wṯ bə·rō·wō·šîm
verses.literal: He lined the interior . . . walls with cedar paneling from the floor of the temple to the ceiling - and he covered the floor . . . with cypress boards
verses.literalPt: Guarneceu as paredes da casa por dentro com tábuas de cedro, cobrindo-as por dentro com madeiras desde o soalho da casa até as traves do teto. Também cobriu o soalho com tábuas de cipreste.

verses.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אַמָּ֜ה מִיַּרְכּוֹתֵי הַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִן־ הַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־ הַקִּיר֑וֹת וַיִּ֤בֶן לוֹ֙ מִבַּ֣יִת לִדְבִ֔יר לְקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh mī·yar·kō·ṯē hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ṣal·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·rā·zîm min- haq·qar·qa‘ ‘aḏ- haq·qî·rō·wṯ way·yi·ḇen lōw mib·ba·yiṯ liḏ·ḇîr lə·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: Do fundo da casa, a vinte cúbitos, fez com tábuas de cedro uma divisão desde o soalho até as traves; e preparou-a por dentro para o oráculo, para o Santo dos Santos.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים בָּאַמָּ֖ה הָיָ֣ה הַבָּ֑יִת ה֖וּא הַהֵיכָ֥ל לִפְנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘îm bā·’am·māh hā·yāh hab·bā·yiṯ hū ha·hê·ḵāl lip̄·nāy
verses.literal: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long
verses.literalPt: A casa, isto é, o templo fronteiro ao oráculo, tinha quarenta cúbitos de comprido.

verses.original: וְאֶ֤רֶז אֶל־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ פְּנִ֔ימָה מִקְלַ֣עַת פְּקָעִ֔ים וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים הַכֹּ֣ל אֶ֔רֶז אֵ֥ין אֶ֖בֶן נִרְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’e·rez ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ pə·nî·māh miq·la·‘aṯ pə·qā·‘îm ū·p̄ə·ṭū·rê ṣiṣ·ṣîm hak·kōl ’e·rez ’ên ’e·ḇen nir·’āh
verses.literal: The cedar . . . paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers Everything was cedar not a stone could be seen
verses.literalPt: A casa por dentro estava forrada de cedro lavrado de botões e de flores abertas; tudo era cedro; não se via pedra.

verses.original: וּדְבִ֧יר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה הֵכִ֑ין לְתִתֵּ֣ן שָׁ֔ם אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·ḇîr bə·ṯō·wḵ- hab·ba·yiṯ mip·pə·nî·māh hê·ḵîn lə·ṯit·tên šām ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Solomon also prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple . . . to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there
verses.literalPt: No meio da casa, na parte mais interior, preparou um oráculo, para pôr nele a arca da Aliança de Jeová.

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֡יר עֶשְׂרִים֩ אַמָּ֨ה אֹ֜רֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִ֧ים אַמָּ֣ה רֹ֗חַב וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְצַ֥ף מִזְבֵּ֖חַ אָֽרֶז׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lip̄·nê had·də·ḇîr ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh ’ō·reḵ wə·‘eś·rîm ’am·māh rō·ḥaḇ wə·‘eś·rîm ’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯōw way·ṣap·pê·hū zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr way·ṣap̄ miz·bê·aḥ ’ā·rez
verses.literal: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long twenty cubits wide and twenty cubits high He overlaid the inside with pure gold and he also overlaid the altar of cedar
verses.literalPt: Dentro do oráculo, havia um espaço de vinte cúbitos de comprimento, vinte de largura e vinte de altura, que cobriu de ouro puro. Cobriu de cedro o altar.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֨ף שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה אֶת־ הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְעַבֵּ֞ר בְּרַתִּיקוֹת זָהָב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣap̄ šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ mip·pə·nî·māh zā·hāḇ sā·ḡūr way·‘ab·bêr bə·rat·tī·qōṯ zā·hāḇ lip̄·nê had·də·ḇîr way·ṣap·pê·hū zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary which was overlaid with gold
verses.literalPt: Salomão cobriu também de ouro puro a casa por dentro e fez passar cadeias de ouro por dentro do oráculo, que cobriu de ouro.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֛יִת צִפָּ֥ה זָהָ֖ב עַד־ תֹּ֣ם כָּל־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְכָל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ לַדְּבִ֖יר צִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- hab·ba·yiṯ ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- hab·bā·yiṯ wə·ḵāl ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ăšer- lad·də·ḇîr ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: So he overlaid with gold the whole interior of the temple until everything . . . was completely finished He also overlaid with gold the entire altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Cobriu inteiramente de ouro a casa toda; também cobriu de ouro o altar todo que pertencia ao oráculo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדְּבִ֔יר שְׁנֵ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bad·də·ḇîr šə·nê ḵə·rū·ḇîm ‘ă·ṣê- šā·men ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ qō·w·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim each ten cubits high out of olive wood
verses.literalPt: No oráculo, fez dois querubins de pau de oliveira, cada um tendo dez cúbitos de alto.

verses.original: וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת כְּנַ֤ף הַכְּרוּב֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת כְּנַ֥ף הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת מִקְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָ֖יו וְעַד־ קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ kə·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ hā·’e·ḥāṯ wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ kə·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ haš·šê·nîṯ ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ miq·ṣō·wṯ kə·nā·p̄āw wə·‘aḏ- qə·ṣō·wṯ kə·nā·p̄āw
verses.literal: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and the other wing was five cubits long as well So the full wingspan - was ten cubits
verses.literalPt: Uma asa do querubim tinha cinco cúbitos, e a outra tinha cinco; desde a extremidade duma asa até a extremidade da outra havia dez cúbitos.

verses.original: וְעֶ֙שֶׂר֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑י מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וְקֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘e·śer bā·’am·māh hak·kə·rūḇ haš·šê·nî mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ wə·qe·ṣeḇ ’e·ḥāḏ liš·nê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm
verses.literal: The second cherub also measured ten cubits both cherubim had the same size . . . and shape
verses.literalPt: O outro querubim também tinha dez cúbitos; ambos os querubins eram da mesma medida e da mesma forma.

verses.original: קוֹמַת֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הָֽאֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן הַכְּר֥וּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: qō·w·maṯ hak·kə·rūḇ hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘e·śer bā·’am·māh wə·ḵên hak·kə·rūḇ haš·šê·nî
verses.literal: and the height of each . . . . . . . . . cherub was ten cubits
verses.literalPt: Um querubim tinha dez cúbitos de alto, assim também o outro.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת־ הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ׀ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֗י וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת־ כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִים֒ וַתִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף־ הָֽאֶחָד֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּכְנַף֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּקִּ֣יר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל־ כָּנָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’eṯ- hak·kə·rū·ḇîm bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·ba·yiṯ hap·pə·nî·mî way·yip̄·rə·śū ’eṯ- kan·p̄ê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm wat·tig·ga‘ kə·nap̄- hā·’e·ḥāḏ baq·qîr ū·ḵə·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ haš·šê·nî nō·ḡa·‘aṯ baq·qîr haš·šê·nî wə·ḵan·p̄ê·hem ’el- tō·wḵ hab·ba·yiṯ nō·ḡə·‘ōṯ kā·nāp̄ ’el- kā·nāp̄
verses.literal: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple Since their wings were spread out the wing of the first cherub touched one wall while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall and in the middle of the room their wingtips . . . touched
verses.literalPt: Pôs os querubins dentro da casa interior; as asas dos querubins estendiam-se, de sorte que a dum tocava numa parede, e a do outro tocava noutra parede; e as suas asas tocavam uma a outra no meio da casa.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־ הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣap̄ ’eṯ- hak·kə·rū·ḇîm zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold
verses.literalPt: Cobriu de ouro os querubins.

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב׀ קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרֹ֔ת וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִלִּפְנִ֖ים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- qî·rō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ mê·saḇ qā·la‘ pit·tū·ḥê miq·lə·‘ō·wṯ kə·rū·ḇîm wə·ṯi·mō·rōṯ ū·p̄ə·ṭū·rê ṣiṣ·ṣîm mil·lip̄·nîm wə·la·ḥî·ṣō·wn
verses.literal: Then he carved the walls all around the temple in both the inner and outer sanctuaries with carved engravings of cherubim palm trees and open flowers
verses.literalPt: Em volta de todas as paredes da casa, tanto na divisão mais interior como na mais exterior, fez de entalhe querubins, palmeiras e flores abertas.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִפְנִ֖ימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- qar·qa‘ hab·ba·yiṯ ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ lip̄·nî·māh wə·la·ḥî·ṣō·wn
verses.literal: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries
verses.literalPt: Também cobriu de ouro o soalho da casa, tanto na divisão mais interior como na mais exterior.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַדְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן הָאַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ pe·ṯaḥ had·də·ḇîr ‘ā·śāh dal·ṯō·wṯ ‘ă·ṣê- šā·men hā·’a·yil mə·zū·zō·wṯ ḥă·mi·šîṯ
verses.literal: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary Solomon constructed doors of olive wood with five-sided doorposts
verses.literalPt: Para a entrada do oráculo, fez de pau de oliveira portas; a verga da porta e as ombreiras constituíam a quinta parte da parede.

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שֶׁמֶן֒ וְקָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵיהֶם מִקְלְע֨וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְתִמֹר֛וֹת וּפְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַיָּ֛רֶד עַל־ הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְעַל־ הַתִּֽמֹר֖וֹת אֶת־ הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê dal·ṯō·wṯ ‘ă·ṣê- še·men wə·qā·la‘ ‘ă·lê·hem miq·lə·‘ō·wṯ kə·rū·ḇîm wə·ṯi·mō·rō·wṯ ū·p̄ə·ṭū·rê ṣiṣ·ṣîm wə·ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ way·yā·reḏ ‘al- hak·kə·rū·ḇîm wə·‘al- hat·ti·mō·rō·wṯ ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: The double doors were made of olive wood and he carved . . . into them cherubim palm trees and open flowers and overlaid . . . the cherubim . . . and palm trees with hammered gold . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim, fabricou de pau de oliveira duas portas; e nelas fez de entalhe querubins, palmeiras e flores abertas, que cobriu de ouro. Também estendeu o ouro sobre os querubins e sobre as palmeiras.

verses.original: וְכֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְפֶ֥תַח הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן מֵאֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên ‘ā·śāh lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ ha·hê·ḵāl mə·zū·zō·wṯ ‘ă·ṣê- šā·men mê·’êṯ rə·ḇi·‘îṯ
verses.literal: In the same way he made four-sided doorposts of olive . . . wood for the sanctuary entrance
verses.literalPt: Assim, para a entrada do templo, fez também de pau de oliveira ombreiras que constituíam a quarta parte da parede;

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַדֶּ֤לֶת הָֽאַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּשְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַדֶּ֥לֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê ḏal·ṯō·wṯ ‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm šə·nê ṣə·lā·‘îm had·de·leṯ hā·’a·ḥaṯ gə·lî·lîm ū·šə·nê qə·lā·‘îm had·de·leṯ haš·šê·nîṯ gə·lî·lîm
verses.literal: The two doors were made of cypress wood and each had . . . two folding panels - -
verses.literalPt: e, de madeira de cipreste, fez duas portas. As duas folhas de cada porta fechavam-se uma sobre outra.

verses.original: וְקָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְתִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּפְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·la‘ kə·rū·ḇîm wə·ṯi·mō·rō·wṯ ū·p̄ə·ṭu·rê ṣiṣ·ṣîm wə·ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ mə·yuš·šār ‘al- ham·mə·ḥuq·qeh
verses.literal: He carved into them cherubim palm trees and open flowers and he overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings
verses.literalPt: Nelas, esculpiu querubins, palmeiras e flores abertas; e cobriu-as de ouro ajustado às figuras entalhadas.

verses.original: וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ šə·lō·šāh ṭū·rê ḡā·zîṯ wə·ṭūr kə·ru·ṯōṯ ’ă·rā·zîm
verses.literal: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams
verses.literalPt: Edificou o átrio interior de três ordens de pedras lavradas e duma ordem de vigas de cedro.

verses.original: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּיֶ֖רַח זִֽו׃
verses.transliteration: baš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇî·‘îṯ yus·saḏ bêṯ Yah·weh bə·ye·raḥ ziw
verses.literal: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign in the month of Ziv
verses.literalPt: Lançou-se o fundamento da Casa de Jeová no quarto ano, no mês de zive.

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָה֩ הָאַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּיֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְכָל־ דְּבָרָ֖יו וּלְכָל־ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וַיִּבְנֵ֖הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh hā·’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh bə·ye·raḥ būl hū ha·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·mî·nî kā·lāh hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḵāl də·ḇā·rāw ū·lə·ḵāl- miš·på̄·ṭō way·yiḇ·nê·hū še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: In the eleventh . . . year in the month of Bul the eighth month the temple was finished in every detail and according to every specification So he built the temple in seven years
verses.literalPt: No undécimo ano, no mês de bul, que é o oitavo mês, foi acabada a casa em todas as suas partes e tal como devia ser. Levou Salomão sete anos para edificá-la.
